Configure and load a project dataset through the Data Input dialog.

The dialog owns source discovery, parsing options, schema inspection, column roles, preview, and loading. The node emits one Dataset artifact.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [I/O](../categories/io.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `DataInput` |
| Search words | csv, tsv, parquet, feather, arrow, ipc, input, load, read, import, file |
| Settings | In its own window (double-click the node) |

## Inputs

None: the node starts a branch of the graph.

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Dataset** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Loaded dataset with source, schema, column-role, row-count, and backing-store metadata. |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| file_path | `file_path` | File | (empty) | `*.csv;*.tsv;*.parquet;*.feather;*.fea;*.arrow;*.ipc;*.zip` | The run | Initial file selected by the dialog. |
| file_type | `file_type` | Choice | `auto` | `auto`, `csv`, `tsv`, `parquet`, `feather`, `arrow`, `ipc`, `zip_text` | The run | Input format. |
| archive_member | `archive_member` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Exact ZIP member paths, one per line; original UTF-8 rows in selection order with SHA-256 provenance; up to 4096 selections / 64 MiB combined text. |
| configured | `configured` | On / off | `false` |   | The editor only | Whether the dialog has applied a source contract. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes, as a data source |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as the data source |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
